seed.one_line_summary: usb: usbip: fix integer overflow in usbip_recv_iso()
seed.vulnerability_summary: Wire-controlled urb->number_of_packets multiplied by descriptor size in a 32-bit int overflows, causing a small kzalloc but a large receive loop write, yielding heap buffer overflow.
seed.vulnerability_pattern: Wire-controlled count multiplied by fixed element size in narrow integer type overflows, producing undersized allocation followed by loop-based writes exceeding the buffer.
